checks: Watch link normalizes to one HTTPS video and fixed privacy-enhanced embed
Exact short/mobile/shorts/live/embed provider URLs reuse validated eleven-character ID
Lookalike/trailing-dot/nonstandard-port hosts never become an embed
Malformed IDs/channel paths/untrusted iframe query are not executable embeds
Timestamp parsing is bounded numeric/hms/fragment only and never forwards arbitrary options
Canva/GoogleSlides exact provider paths are references only, no embedding
PowerPoint file/tool links remain reference links without conversion or arbitrary preview
General HTTP links are explicit insecure references, never fetched automatically
SSR never includes iframe or thumbnails before explicit viewer consent
External reference actions use new-tab/noopener/noreferrer and no-referrer
Unsafe URL note does not echo a credential-bearing input or clickable action
Resource title is escaped and inline math never adds nested link/button controls
Empty resources are absent, malformed nonempty resources have clear safe state
All supported UI locales include explicit connection consent and source action
Time labels are deterministic and reject noninteger/out-of-range input
Pure inspection/SSR preserves original input and makes no provider/network request
scope: Actual URL inspection and React SSR of shared component; authored URLs only. No provider availability/private permission/video watching/backend authorization proof.
